notes.title: Backrooms: Exploration – Full Release Trailer - May 2nd
Backrooms: Found Footage - Release Date
notes.notes:
Backrooms: Found Footage - is releasing in 2 weeks! Mark your calendars, for October 25th! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/0c565ff3a73295afdeabfe7dac8ef4f1bbb9288a.jpg

I'm more than happy to announce that my first game ever is releasing this month, just in time for Halloween! This game is a short "Backrooms" -experience, where you play as a Young Alex who finds out that realities have collapsed between the real world and the Backrooms. You're lucky to have a camera, so you can record all of the weird things you see during your journey. In this game, you have 2 different endings and it's up to you which one you decide to take. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204871/84362e41813315f58849acc8cde9dfbb49980a3d.jpg


See you on October 25th!
